mcq_drop.why: opinion/debate item ('best reflects historical debate'); not APPSC style

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: ascending (smallest first) is Sangrahana-Kharvatika-Dronamukha-Sthaniya; keyed option 4 is neither order (option 3 is descending)
garbled: options mixed with a Revolt-of-1857 match question; no key
wrong topic: Gandhi's boycott / national movement

patterns: Direct one-liner 'which officer was in charge of X': Samaharta (revenue), Pautavadhyaksha (weights and measures), Sitadhyaksha (crown land), Pradeshtha (justice), Dandapala (army - APPSC key).
Revenue-term meanings asked singly: Sita = crown land revenue, Pranaya = emergency tax; distractors are literal/joke meanings.
Settlement-unit ordering (Sthaniya 800, Dronamukha 400, Kharvatika 200, Sangrahana 10) and Saptanga order (7th = Mitra) are recurring sequence traps.
Ashokan district officers (Rajuka, Pradeshika, Yukta) and Megasthenes' municipal boards (births and deaths registration) recur.
App leans heavily on multi-statement and 4-pair match items; PYQs are mostly single-fact direct questions.
